claims: Katie Nolan is a sports broadcaster and media personality.
Katie Nolan advanced to the finals as a runner-up in Season 2 of Celebrity Jeopardy!.
Katie Nolan won $100,000 for the Association for Women in Sports Media (AWSM).
Katie Nolan returned for the Celebrity Jeopardy!: All-Stars tournament in March 2026.
Katie Nolan faced off against Rachel Dratch and Mark Duplass.
Katie Nolan won her quarterfinal game against Christopher Meloni and Sherri Shepherd in Season 2 of Celebrity Jeopardy!.
Katie Nolan won her semifinal game against Steven Weber and Dulé Hill in Season 2 of Celebrity Jeopardy!.
Katie Nolan placed third in the Season 2 finals of Celebrity Jeopardy!.
Lisa Ann Walter won the $1 million grand prize in the Season 2 finals of Celebrity Jeopardy!.
Katie Nolan joined a field of 21 celebrities in the Celebrity Jeopardy! All-Stars tournament
